name: Valdelacasa de Tajo (Spain)
description: White field with a blue triangle at the lower hoist and a green triangle at the lower fly meeting at the middle of the lower edge, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Valdelacasa de Tajo (a cardinal's hat, a house above waves and a tree).
history: Municipal flag of Valdelacasa de Tajo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Valdelacasa de Tajo arms — cardinal's hat, house above waves and tree
